title: Introduction to New Features in CLO2024.0: Experience More Powerful Knitwear Performance!
description: The new CLO 2024.0 version is now online! The brand-new version naming will help you effectively distinguish between released versions and upcoming ones. In version 2024.0, CLO technical experts will guide you through a comprehensive understanding of CLO-SET account integration, knitwear product performance, the brand-new CLO interface design, and a series of product experience upgrades. Upgrade to CLO 2024.0 and weave unlimited possibilities!
transcript:
Hello everyone, I am Celia. Today, Andy and I will introduce you to the new features of Closet 2024.0.  
This time, the new features mainly include nine aspects: main functions, documents, 2D, 3D, virtual models, materials, modes, rendering, and Closet.  
This live broadcast is divided into two stages. In the first half, I will introduce the first four aspects, and the latter part will be explained by Andy.  
Let's start today's introduction.  

First of all, I will introduce the main features of the update.  

The first is about account collection.  
From the 2024 version, individual users can now access all Closet products through a collection account.  
The collection account means that users can use all services and software provided by Closet without registering individually with separate email accounts.  
When you log in using the collection account,  
you will automatically use your email to log in to all Closet-related services, including Closet software, Closet platform, Connect Business, Marvelous Designer, and Genie, instead of logging in with your user ID.  
Using the collection account can make your workflow smoother.  
Additionally, by using the Closet account, you can greatly reduce the risk of managing multiple accounts and easily manage and update account information on one page.  
Even if the account is collected,  
all data, assets, and subscriptions in the existing account will remain unchanged.  
You can continue to download and use software licenses and purchase projects.  
Currently, the collection account is only for individual users.  
Enterprise users do not need to take any additional actions.  
For new users, the collection account will be automatically created upon registration.  

Next, let's look at the operation process of the collection account for existing users.  
For existing users,  
the current account will be merged based on your registered email address.  
When logging in from Closet software,  
use the existing license ID and password in the login window.  
At this time, a collection account creation window will appear.  
Click OK to enter the Closet login page.  
Click Create Account to complete mobile phone number verification and agree to the terms and conditions.  
You will use the Closet license ID and password you entered to create a collection account.  
If you have registered a Closet account with the same email address,  
Closet will automatically match the email and convert it into a unified collection account.  
If Closet does not find an account registered with the same email address,  
it will create a Closet account and convert it into a collection account.  
If you use Closet software and Closet simultaneously but with different email addresses,  
you can connect to the email account you prefer.  
If you integrate the existing Closet account with the Closet account,  
you can use the files stored and downloaded in the account as before.  
If you want to connect to the Closet account you are using,  
you can contact us to help merge the emails related to your accounts.  
In the future, we will develop this feature to allow users to connect directly.  
After completing the conversion of the collection account,  
you can automatically log into Closet software by saving the ID and password as before.  
Additionally, you can also create a collection account for existing users on the official Closet website.  
Visit the Closet official website and click the Login button.  
Log in with your existing Closet ID and password.  
At this time, a window to create and generate your collection account will appear.  
Click Confirm.  
Once the collection account is digitized,  
it is linked to the Closet account.  
When entering the Closet login window,  
complete the collection account process.  
After the 2024 update, you only need to perform the above steps once when you first connect and set up the integrated account, and after conversion, no further integration is needed.  
Finally, if you want to use an email account, you must use the same email address across all cloud services.  
If you have questions, you can check the help center website related to the integrated account in the video description.  
Using the integrated account, you will cooperate with all cloud services and easily manage your account information on one page.  

We have been researching and developing to change the appearance and performance of cloud-based needle products.  
Previously, we had to create various stickers manually based on textures or materials to express the needle structure.  
From the new version, the material type has added an option for needle clothing, which starts from the needle product's structure to help us show a more realistic needle product appearance.  
Since the needle organization is expressed by a grid, it is very natural to simulate.  
Select a piece of needle material in the software.  
In the bottom attribute editor, an option for needle clothing has been added in the material type.  
Add the material type and change it to needle clothing.  
At this time, the attribute editor will also adjust to options used in the new needle clothing.  
After modifying the settings, you can check the effect in the 3D window.  

First, we can switch between different preset needles.  
We can switch between different preset needles.  
First, we prepare the first preset needles.  
To truly show the texture of the needle and thread, the surface of the needle and thread is also applied with a hairline sticker.  
If you delete the hairline sticker, you can see that the edge thread's shadow becomes lighter.  
Ctrl-Z can undo this.  
Additionally, you can set the number of threads used on each bone thread.  
You can set a value between 1 and 6.  
Below, you can see that the colors of each bone thread can be set.  
Click on the color swatch on the right to assign different colors to each bone thread.  

To naturally express the seam of the needle and thread clothing, we use the option to create a seam by default.  
By creating a thread line on the sewing line connected to the sewing line and the outside edge of the board,  
the needle and thread of the entire clothing can be naturally realized.  
The length of the seam curve can control the seam length extending beyond the board's edge.  
The lower the number, the shorter the seam length and the longer the needle and thread length.  
If the seam curve is reduced with the deep seam option enabled, the seam line and the outside of the board will become even.  
The needle and thread will turn to the opposite side of the board.  
As mentioned earlier, the needle and thread clothing has a grid structure, so it affects 3D operations and rendering speed.  
Especially, the higher the embroidery density, the more grids are calculated, increasing the impact on speed.  
Therefore, after completing the needle and thread clothing attributes, you can use it to control the speed in the 3D window.  

Next, we will pre-use the fabric made by the needle and thread clothing preset applied separately to clothes.  
Open rendering to see the result.  
You can see that the needle and thread clothing's performance is now more natural and rich than before.  
In addition to needle and thread clothing, you can also use it to control speed in the 3D window.  

Finally, needle and thread clothing is a material usable only in clothes, so it is difficult to export as external formats like OBJ, FBX, or GLTF, or to save as an image.  
Therefore, you can store processed needle and thread clothing as a project file or save the fabric as a ZFAB file.  
Using this technology, the visual effect of needle and thread clothing has greatly improved.  
You can easily create more realistic needle and thread fabrics by adjusting presets and settings.  
If you have any thoughts or opinions on needle and thread clothing, please scan the QR code.  
Your feedback will help us further optimize this function.  

From version 2024.0, the user interface of CLOUD starts to be updated.  
The new interface is more intuitive and efficient, improving user experience.  

First is the overall update of the CLOUD color system.  
Generally, the overall color and text of the software have been updated.  
First is the update of the file opening dialog.  
Using the DXF file as an example,  
in the DXF window, the selected frame is displayed in blue, which is more intuitive and easier to understand.  
In the main menu, when the mouse hovers over the required content,  
not only the file name but also the menu itself will show more intuitively.  
Additionally, icon designs in the software have become clearer and easier to visually distinguish.  
Icons in the 2D toolbar, 3D toolbar, and object window have been updated.  
Also, icons in the visually productive tool tab are divided into open and save icons on the right Sylphid.  
The display of the field card and side view is now clearer.  
The update has optimized icon layouts in the 2D and 3D windows.  
In the new version, users can open or close each topic using corresponding icons,  
making it clearer which display views are active or inactive.  
After the improvement, users can directly control the display status of 3D and 2D views.  
Similarly, in the upper left corner of the 3D and 2D windows, you can see the icon for switching views.  
If there is only one menu in each topic, you can click the icon to toggle it.  
If multiple options exist, hovering over the menu will show a re-selection icon and the option name,  
making it convenient to check display mode status.  
Interface design will continue to improve in future versions. Please look forward to subsequent updates.  

Next is an update on file display.  
Starting from 2024, files such as ZP-RJ project files, ZP-AC clothing files, AVT virtual models, clothes, accessories, etc., are now displayed in the folder.  
After the update, ZP-RJ project files will be displayed with software icons.  
The new software icon will appear in the lower right corner of the filter.  
Opening a Cloud ZP-RJ project file,  
finding the file storage project in software, and saving again,  
you can see that the new version still stores ZP-RJ project files and PNG filters.  
ZP-RJ project files will also display as filters,  
with the new software icon in the lower right corner.  
Therefore, when sharing files later,  
you do not need to send PNG filters simultaneously, and you can preview the files.  

Next is an update on 2D-related functions.  
In the new version,  
you can add custom 2D measurements to stickers.  
When measuring sticker positions,  
you usually need to measure the distance between them and specific points on the board.  
Now you can do this through the new function.  
First, select the adjustment sticker tool.  
Right-click on the sticker.  
Find the custom 2D measurement tool.  
Then select the point you want to refer to outside the board.  
For example, click on the high point on the board.  
After adding custom 2D measurements,  
it will display at the bottom of the 2D measurement section in the attribute editor.  
You can enter its name here.  
Next to the name, you can display or hide the measurement value through the review window.  
Click the small trash can icon to delete the custom 2D measurement value.  
You can also measure the distance from the sticker to the left and bottom sides.  
Use the adjustment sticker tool, right-click the sticker, select custom 2D measurement, then confirm the point outside the board.  
In the attribute editor, you can rename the measurement value.  
If you have a horse-drawn costume, you can check measurement values of each horse-drawn size by changing the size of the horse.  
This tool helps you match sticker measurement values with specific points on the board.  

From the new version, you can easily replace the board outline.  
The new replacement line function in the 2D window can replace one or more lines in the board with another line.  
For example, I will use this chain store as an example.  
Now all boards of this suit are finished.  
Next, we will modify the board.  
For example, here we modify one side of the sleeve.  
The other side can use the replacement line function to maintain shape matching.  
Select the edit board tool.  
Right-click the line you modified.  
In the menu, select copy.  
Then, on the other side of the sleeve, right-click again.  
In the pop-up menu, select replacement line section.  
You can see the line section to be replaced is previewed in yellow.  
Simultaneously, the replacement line section window pops up with options.  
First, select the option to copy one or more lines of different length from the replacement line section.  
Since both sleeve sides have the same length, keep the start direction without changes.  
At the bottom, two options: vertical rotation and horizontal rotation.  
Select these to rotate the line section vertically and/or horizontally.  
The direction depends on the line section you want to replace.  
I want both sleeve sides symmetrical.  
The bent part of the line is below.  
Select horizontal rotation to turn the bent part upward.  
According to the preview, also select vertical rotation.  
Through this method, we adjust the sleeve shape.  
After selection, click OK to apply modifications.  
Open simulation to see the 3D result.  
Similarly, you can replace multiple lines.  
For example, modify the shape.  
After modification, use the replacement line section function to keep front and collar matching.  
Press Shift to select all lines needing matching.  
Right-click on the line section, and select replacement line section.  
For line sections with different lengths, use the direction option to assign new measurement values.  
Selecting Start means the line section increases only downward at the bottom and does not affect the shoulder line.  
Selecting Both Ends moves both ends of the line, distributing measurement values evenly.  
Start and End directions are opposite.  
Move points to adjust length.  
The starting and ending directions depend on panel creation and may vary.  
For the current case, select Start and do not select flip.  
After clicking OK, all important lines are replaced, including internal lines connected to the outside, which move correctly.  
After modification, open simulation to view results.  
Overall, replacing lines makes it more convenient and accurate to change the board outline.  

From the new version, we added the function to convert multiple lines to straight lines.  
In the 2D window, select the edit lines tool.  
Select lines to convert on the board.  
Right-click selected lines and choose convert all to straight lines.  
This tool helps edit and adjust the board efficiently.  

Additionally, in the 2D vertical menu,  
we added the option to display or hide the board angle.  
The fourth button in the information display shows the angle.  
Click to activate and see the board angle.  

Since the last version, the 2D window added the option to display and hide shrinkage.  
To better suit production, we can now arrange the board according to shrinkage.  
For example, using jeans:  
After washing, the jeans shrinkage rate is 80%.  
Ctrl-A to select all boards.  
Change horizontal shrinkage rate to 80% in the property editor.  
Enter hard-to-sew mode.  
You can see the board is now actual size.  
In the property editor, two board size options: actual size and shrinkage rate.  
Select shrinkage rate.  
The shrinkage board displays in hard-to-sew editor.  
Click arrange.  
After arranging, you can switch to actual size anytime to rearrange.  
Return to simulation mode.  
Conversely, you can stretch the board.  
For example, set horizontal shrinkage rate to 120%.  
Repeat the arranging process for the enlarged board.  

Next is a 3D update.  
First, optimization of grid type.  
The grid type of the optimized board uses an automatic overlap algorithm.  
The 3D grid helps build 3D clothing and boards.  
Cloud supports two grid types: triangle grid and quadrilateral grid.  
Triangle grid shows triangular shapes.  
Quadrilateral grid shows quadrilateral shapes.  
The 3D and 2D windows have grid display options.  
Grid type settings are at the bottom of the parameter editor.  
There are two options: triangle and quadrilateral.  
The quadrilateral grid algorithm is optimized in 2024.0 and renamed quadrilateral optimization.  
Choosing quadrilateral optimization changes grid appearance in 3D and 2D windows accordingly.  
In the 3D window, right-click on the board to access grid type.  
After changing to quadrilateral optimization, grid appearance and 3D appearance update.  
It is now more convenient to change grid types in 3D and 2D windows.  

Additionally, wind control in the 3D window has been optimized.  
Wind control is important for natural fabric movement according to airflow.  
Open wind control in the 3D window to display it.  
You can change wind control position and direction by selecting it.  
Activate it in the parameter editor.  
Open simulation to check effects.  
To add more wind controllers, right-click the current wind controller and click Copy.  
Adjust position, direction, and strength of the copied controller.  
To delete, right-click the wind controller and delete.  
In the new version, you can add multiple wind controllers to show mixed airflow from different directions.  

You can also set conflicts between scene and props to ensure stable interaction between clothes or props and environment.  
Use scenes and props in Connect Sunshine, then add clothes or props to the project.  
Previously, items like scarves and necklaces would pass through props and drop to the ground during simulation.  
Now, open the conflict setting for the scene and props.  
Select the sofa in the model editor, open conflict under specifications, then open simulation.  
You can see scarves and necklaces remain stable on the sofa.  
You can adjust conflict thickness to set distance between props and template-created props.  
This function allows more flexible use of scene props for realistic simulation.  

Next is the fix for folding board shadow problems.  
Previously, unnatural shadows appeared on folding boards, especially at the center and sides where balance was opened.  
Users had to take extra steps to solve this, such as removing parallel relationships or reducing particle diameter.  
Based on user feedback, the new version optimizes and solves folding board shadow issues without extra steps,  
allowing parallel editing relationships to be maintained.  
This simplifies user operations and suits most clothing styles.  

Next, we explain new virtual model functions.  
First, the human face generator supporting men and children.  
In version 7.3.5.0, we introduced the virtual model human face generator function.  
You can add keywords or images from virtual model face characteristics.  
Previously limited to female models,  
now this function supports male, boys, and girls virtual models.  
Let's import a male virtual model.  
In the 3D window, add the male virtual model file.  
In the virtual model main menu, select the human face generator function.  
A new gender download menu appears: men, boys, girls, and women.  
Select men.  
Age and race options can be kept unchanged or selected between 10 and 80 years old.  
The keyword prompt works like other AI functions on Cloud.  
Use words, not long sentences.  
Click the human face generator image at the top.  
You can change gender here.  
Click upload to load an image.  
Ensure the image is a front-facing photo without hair, glasses, or shadows blocking background.  
Recommended resolution is 1080 ppi or higher for better results.  
This function now suits male and female virtual models aged 7 to 20 years old.  
It is not suitable for virtual models under 7 years old.  
The function is in testing and will be optimized based on feedback.  

Next, support for DAS Genesis 9 virtual models.  
In the last 7.3 update, we released DAS virtual model support for Genesis 8.  
Now, the automatic conversion function is expanded to support Genesis 9 virtual models.  
Let's see the operation process.  
Go to virtual model main menu, click automatic virtual model conversion.  
A window pops up for automatic conversion.  
Click the file button next to 3D model file to open your virtual model.  
Open the required virtual model.  
Select the embedded DAS Genesis 9 virtual model.  
Click open.  
The model loads into the 3D window.  
Choose virtual model gender.  
Choose automatic or custom conversion options.  
Choose skin type.  
On the left of skin type, see different conversion types.  
Select all three conversion types.  
After conversion, you get three virtual models.  
Save file path and rename.  
Click convert.  
Cloud starts converting DAS virtual model to Cloud virtual model.  
After completion, a window appears.  
Open file folder to see converted virtual model.  

Next, configuration and skin type of DAS Genesis 9 virtual model.  
In 2024, virtual model configuration expands flexibility.  
Originally used by single virtual model, now self-defined options include multiple virtual models.  
Select virtual model in folder, open file folder to see new virtual models.  
Models like Sasha, Melody, and Oliver can be downloaded from Connect.  
Download any child virtual model.  
In 3D window, click virtual model.  
In attribute editor, see skin type of child virtual model.  
Switch between virtual models in download menu.  
Switch skin type of girl virtual model.  
Switch boy virtual model between Oliver and Melody.  
In model configuration, self-define each option like adult virtual models.  
Switch eyebrows and lips of other virtual models.  
If you want Sasha's eyebrows on Melody's face, select Sasha from eyebrows download menu.  
Choose integrated options like green, plus or minus.  
Load boy virtual model and self-define hair, skin, eyebrows, eyes, and lips colors.  
Note: If virtual models were downloaded before, download them again from Connect to use this function.  
Now you can self-define child virtual models based on personal aesthetics.  

Next, how to connect virtual models to arrangement points.  
This function enhances arrangement points.  
It supports virtual models and Amano models.  
Operation:  
Open arrangement point in 3D window version 7.3.  
Right-click Amano model and select virtual model and costume.  
Use positioning ball.  
When moving Amano model, arrangement point moves simultaneously, simplifying workflow and increasing efficiency.  

Next, optimize virtual models, arrangement board, and arrangement point.  
Explain how to use arrangement point in 3D window version 7.3.  
Starting with Clo 2024, users can add arrangement points and boards for multiple virtual models in one scene.  
Operation:  
Add multiple virtual models to scene.  
Open arrangement point and board for the virtual models.  
You can see both virtual models.  
On left column, click virtual model, open virtual model editor, find arrangement.  
Select needed virtual model from menu.  
In arrangement panel section, add or delete arrangement panels.  
Adjust parameters to change position and size.  
After adding arrangement panel, add arrangement points on right side.  
Adjust position with parameters.  
With 2024 update, arrangement points on multiple virtual models can be arranged simultaneously.  

Next, improvement of Connect human model.  
Connect store's five-faced human models updated.  
Now their size can be edited.  
You can edit these models in Cloud's virtual model editor.  
First, log into old Connect through Cloud software.  
Click Connect.  
Select virtual model.  
Click Connect.  
Select free option.  
Scroll down to find five-faced human or virtual models.  
Drag male or female virtual model to 3D window.  
Open virtual model editor.  
Define size as needed.  
Process is same as adjusting Cloud virtual models.  
Select weight as parameter.  
Use presets to change body shape.  
Save size if needed for reuse.  
Now you can test with five-faced human models of different editable sizes.  

Next, new material features.  
First, dual-head zipper.  
3D zipper tool now provides single-head and dual-head zippers.  
Allows faster creation of styles like double-head zipper jackets and bags.  
Operation:  
Select zipper tool in 3D window.  
Install zipper on 3D or 2D version.  
Press button at start position.  
Double-click at end to complete one side.  
Repeat for other side.  
After adding zipper, simulate fit.  
Select zipper in 3D window.  
In attribute editor, change type from single-head to dual-head zipper.  
Direction option below type sets double-head.  
Means two zippers at top and bottom ends of zipper.  
Changing to dual-head places zippers in middle of entire zipper.  
You can pull zipper box or open zipper.  
Use dual-head zipper to adjust zipper shape and function.  
Adjust parameters according to design.  
Adjust zipper size and length as desired.  
Dual-head zipper completed.  

Next, copy and paste when copying templates.  
Previously, only buttons and OPJ copy-paste were kept.  
Other materials were lost when copying templates.  
In new version, all materials are preserved.  
Operation:  
In package, Osmark zipper made with sewing machine attached to side of zipper.  
Currently, only half made.  
Previously, copying templates lost sewing machine and zipper side.  
Had to copy sewing machine separately and add zipper side again, which was time-consuming.  
In 2024, copying templates keeps sewing machine and zipper side.  
Copy other half as back and arrange.  
Sew sides and bottom together and simulate.  
All sewing machine and zipper sides retained.  
Add 3D zipper at top of package.  
Add zipper in 2D version for easier operation.  
Blue dots in 3D and 2D windows help identify start direction for adding zipper.  
After adding 3D zipper and pre-made hand, Osmark zipper package is faster with copy material function.  
Suitable for simple copy-paste operations like sewing, pasting, stitching, and buttons.  
However, templates cannot yet be copied directly.  
This operation requires connecting templates and pasting.  
Further improvements expected in future versions.  

Next, create internal shapes from templates.  
You can convert template outlines into internal lines.  
Helpful for making stamps or marking template locations.  
Operation:  
Add template to skirt.  
Template is a PNG with no background.  
Right-click template, select internal shape.  
Internal line created by butterfly outline.  
If internal line differs in detail from outline, adjust line slightly.  
This function saves time.  
Next, make skirt outline.  

Next, update related to model.  
First, UI of old block library deleted in Cloud.  
In last 7.3 update, there were two block libraries: new and old.  
In 2024, old block library editor mode and UI removed due to low usage.  
Previously, old block library remained on left side, causing duplicate libraries.  
You could register and use blocks in old block library mode.  
In 2024, old block library editor and mode are removed; new block library renamed block library.  
You can register and use it as block library.  
We decided to remove old block library mode and UI because of low frequency after adding new block library.  

Next, convert old block library files and upload to new block library.  
Old block library not supported in 2024, but function added to convert and upload old files to new block library.  
To import old block library files for use in 2024, operation:  
Upload block preview from new block library in 2024.  
Simulate it.  
Import ZBLC file, a component file from early versions, used to change embroidery on T-shirt files.  
Note: component structure in old files matches new block library structure, so only position and sewing line retained and converted.  
ZBLC block file exports from file window to 3D window, info window pops up.  
ZBLC file actively loaded as new block file.  
You need to save it to use as complete new block file.  
To prevent future prompts when loading older block files, select “do not show again” option.  
Open file.  
In 3D window, old block file converted to new.  
Click Edit Embroidery Tool to see sewing line sealed.  
To convert sleeve version to new sleeve file in new block file, add ZMOD file by clicking Add button.  
Since old block files no longer supported in 2024, old files need to be added to new block box.  
Import shirt block file from previous version.  
Prompt appears that file will be added as new block file.  
Previously created parts need conversion and registration via upload.  
This process will be automated in future.  

Next, add option to set required folder as default folder.  
In 7.3, enterprise users using new block files often used network drives like OneDrive or Google Drive for sharing.  
New block file did not allow changing default folder, requiring copy-paste each time, causing inconvenience.  
In Cloud 2024, added option to set required folder as default.  
On Cloud 2024 interface, click Settings in main menu, then User Identification, then Others, then Blockcharts, then default folder.  
Click file folder icon on right.  
In folder selection window, select required folder as default, then click Close.  
Check if default folder set successfully.  
Open blockcharts.  
To add new group, click refresh, then Add Group.  
In open file window, default folder displays.  
When creating blockchart for current clothing style, click file in main menu, then Style.  
Blockchart generator window appears with default folder in search section.  
Click Add.  
Open file window shows default folder.  
This confirms default folder successfully set.  
Cloud 2024 adds option to set data folder as default, facilitating blockchart creation and sharing.  

Next, new rendering function update: save rotating animation with transparent background.  
Previously, transparency option not selectable, so software could not render GIF rotating images or animations with transparent background.  
Since Cloud 2024, transparency option available, enabling saving of GIF rotating images and animations with transparent background.  
Operation:  
In 2024 interface, click Render in main menu.  
In rendering window, click image/video attribute.  
In attribute editor, select Rotate Image or Animation.  
Save as GIF.  
In background column, transparency option is selectable (not gray).  
After setting, click Final Render.  
A rotating GIF animation with transparent background is generated.  
Open GIF to check effect.  
This allows displaying rotating animations on different platforms conveniently.  

Finally, color updates.  
Since Cloud 7.3 update, color function and structure improved for easier adjustment and setup.  
You can apply different materials with different attributes to each color, such as fabric.  
When applying material to board, you can choose how to apply it to each color.  
Examples:  

Example 1: Color operation.  
Create a color from scratch.  
Open editor in main menu.  
Click Color, open Color window, click Color editor.  
Click plus sign at upper right to add color.  
Create different color for this GIF.  
When applying same material, you want different colors for each color type.  
Change second GIF color to fabric color.  
Select second GIF.  
Select Baseball GK fabric applied to GIF.  
In attribute editor color section, change fabric color.  
Click Apply and Close.  
Click Update in upper left of color editor window to see effect.  
To keep changed color and apply different materials only to designated colors, do the following:  
Click Color 2 (third color).  
To apply different materials, first add material to object window.  
Double-click GIF, select materials, add them separately to object window.  
In 3D window, select Baseball GK.  
Click Apply to selected version or drag material to selected version.  
Option window appears for applying material to color.  
Select first option and click Apply to current color.  
Click OK to apply.  
Click Update to see Baseball GK material in Color 2 changed as desired.  
Materials in Color A and Color 1 remain unchanged.  
Only Color 2 material changed.  

Under current color, select baseball GK material block to highlight.  
Dragging another material to material block applies only to current color automatically.  
Effect and application same as current color; no need to select in window.  
Click Update to confirm color change effect.  

To change same material type for all colors and enable easy future modification, do the following:  
Apply leather fabric (changed to patterned fabric) to GIF.  
Select all embroidered panels in 3D window.  
Drag new embroidered fabric added to 3D window to embroidered panels.  
In color window applied to spring ball, select second to apply to all colors.  
Change color if needed.  
Click OK and Update.  
All embroidered panels change to patterned fabric.  
Select new sleeve panel in list.  
New fabric type appears.  
Change color in attribute editor.  
Click Update to apply color to all embroidered panels.  

To apply same material type to two designated colors instead of three visible colors, do the following:  
In color editor, hold Shift and click patterned fabric in colors 1 and 2.  
Drag fabric in 3D window to selected object.  
Click Update to confirm.  
Only colors 1 and 2 change.  
To change color applied only to colors 1 and 2, link is used.  
To cancel link and edit color 2 separately, click fabric type in color editor on right.  
Click Unlink all colors.  
Modify fabric block color of color 2 separately.  
After unlinking, color of fabric can be changed individually.  

To use same fabric type in selected fabric but modify color and fabric type separately for designated flag, do:  
Select sleeve fabric in 3D window.  
Drag Baseball GT Sleeves fabric to selected sleeve fabric.  
Select third option in window: Use all colors.  
Cancel link to change color separately.  
Click OK.  
Select fabric block in third color.  
Change color in attribute editor and click Update.  
Colors of sleeve fabric change, only third designated color changes separately.  

If options are fixed, save them for reuse to avoid repeated selection.  
To keep selected option, choose "apply current settings" at bottom of color window.  
To change saved option or reapply, change in user definition settings.  
Location: main menu, Settings, OK.  
Fabric color has improved with diversified and convenient working methods.  
Use fabric color editor efficiently.  

Compatibility with previous color files:  
When loading files created before 7.3 or 7.3 projects in new version, a window pops up.  
Before 7.3, even if each color used same fabric, fabrics were applied individually and not identified as same.  
From 7.3 and 2024, function improved to identify same fabrics applied to different colors.  
Window allows choosing how to apply fabric structure.  
Improves counting total fabric usage in future.  
Recommended to select Yes to merge fabrics.  
Click Yes to load color file and display all colors in object window.  
Same fabric types are linked and loaded as one fabric.  
If CFAB fabric file was created before 7.3 and contains color info,  
it is improved in new version to contain only one fabric info.  
To load pre-7.3 CFAB files with color info, put CFAB file into object window.  
A new window appears.  
Click Yes to load all colors as separate CFAB files.  
Click No to load object selected when saving as single fabric.  
Opening fabric file in existing fabric via attribute editor or dragging into CFAB replaces with single fabric selected when saving.  
No popup appears.  
Fabric color and working methods updated for more convenience.  
Fabric color editor can be used more efficiently.  

Next, new features of Closet.  
After 3D file completion, users can upload it to our cloud platform Closet for further collaboration.  
New Closet users can explore functions on Closet website.  
This year, more functions added to enhance seamless communication and workflow of 3D assets.  

Operation process of new Closet functions:  
In cloud software, users can upload finished 3D clothing seamlessly to Closet.  
Click Closet button in upper right to open upload page.  
Select location (specific studio).  
Click upload button.  
After uploading, users can share file with others on the right.  
Choose people or enter email.  
After selecting, click Share.  
Users can also share files with a group via team function.  
Select Group 1.  
Select all members and share.  
After completion, collaborators receive legal notice.  
Users manage notice board and team management.  
Specify team label.  
Click Create New Team.  
Fill team info and member emails.  
Click Create.  
Team creation completed.  

When users check files on content page, Closet provides 3D real-time viewfinder to check machine structure.  
Includes display options similar to Closet, such as textured surface and semi-transparent surface.  
Closet also added hard drive to viewfinder to help check clothing appearance.  
Besides 3D viewfinder, users can check document info in left area, such as style name, product name, etc.  
If 3D file creates clothing in Closet (e.g., top garment or pants), users can use link content to check which clothing is created in the file, helping better track and manage digital assets.  

After checking 3D clothing structure, users can use comments to share feedback.  
For example, add logo tags to print in comments.  
Drag relevant images to positions as comment copies.  
Others can preview comments.  
If necessary, users can mark comments in 3D window with viewfinder.  
Through collaboration, users can modify files and upload latest versions to Closet.  

If users lack time to render in Closet, they can render in Closet.  
Rendering settings are basically the same as in Closet, such as resolution and quality.  
After update, users can render files as rotating images and save as .jf or video formats.  
After rendering, preview through screenshot on left side of single machine.  
Use buttons on bottom right to download rotating image or video.  
Here is the video after download.  

Through these steps, users can collaborate and design comments with others.  
More new Closet functions will be released in the coming weeks.

chunks.content: ## Introduction to CLO 2024.0 New Features This document details the new features introduced in CLO 2024.0, focusing on account management, material enhancements, user interface updates, 2D and 3D workflow improvements, virtual model advancements, material tools, rendering updates, and the CLO cloud platform (Closet). These features improve knitwear performance, collaboration, and design efficiency. --- ## Account Collection and Unified Login System This section explains the new collection account system introduced in CLO 2024.0, which unifies login across all CLO services for individual users, simplifying account management and enhancing workflow continuity. - **Collection Account Overview**: Individual users can now access all CLO products (CLO software, CLO platform, Connect Business, Marvelous Designer, Genie) through a single collection account linked to their email address. This eliminates the need to manage multiple accounts or separate logins. - **Benefits**: - Single email login for all CLO-related services - Centralized account information management - Existing data, assets, and subscriptions remain intact after account integration - Enterprise users are unaffected and do not need to take action - New users automatically get a collection account upon registration - **Migration Process for Existing Users**: - Login with existing license ID and password triggers collection account creation prompt - Mobile phone verification and acceptance of terms complete the process - Accounts with matching emails are merged automatically; if no match, a new collection account is created - Users can manually merge accounts with different emails by contacting support (future direct linking planned) - Post-conversion, users can log in as before, with saved credentials - Alternatively, users can create collection accounts via the CLO official website login page - **Important Notes**: - Use the same email address across all cloud services for seamless integration - Help center resources are available for additional guidance --- ## Needle and Thread Clothing Material Enhancements This section covers the new material type "needle clothing" designed for realistic knitwear simulation, improving visual fidelity and performance in CLO 2024.0. - **Material Type Addition**: The "needle clothing" material type models knitwear based on the actual needle structure, represented by a grid system for natural simulation.

**Custom 2D Measurements on Stickers**: - Users can now measure distances from stickers to arbitrary points outside the board - Operation: Right-click sticker → Custom 2D Measurement → Select reference point (e.g., high point on board) - Measurements display in attribute editor with customizable names and visibility toggles - Can be deleted or renamed as needed - Facilitates precise matching of sticker positions to board features or horse sizes - **Replacement Line Function**: - Allows replacing one or more lines on a board with another line segment for shape matching, preserving symmetry (e.g., sleeve sides) - Operation involves copying the edited line, selecting the target line section, and applying vertical/horizontal rotations for alignment - Supports replacing multiple lines simultaneously with options to adjust measurement value distribution (start, both ends) and direction flipping - After replacement, internal connected lines move correctly, maintaining board integrity - Facilitates accurate and efficient board outline modifications - **Convert Lines to Straight Lines**: - Selected lines in the 2D window can be converted to straight lines for simplified editing - Operation: Select lines, right-click → Convert all to straight lines - **Board Angle Display**: - Added toggle to show/hide board angles in the 2D vertical menu (fourth button in information display) - **Shrinkage Display and Board Arrangement**: - Boards can be arranged according to shrinkage rates for better production accuracy (e.g., jeans with 80% shrinkage after washing) - Operation: Select all boards → Set horizontal shrinkage rate → Enable shrinkage display mode → Arrange boards accordingly - Supports both shrinkage and stretching (e.g., 120% for enlarged boards) - Users can switch between actual size and shrinkage modes during workflow --- ## 3D Window Enhancements and Simulation Controls This section covers improvements to 3D grid types, wind simulation, scene-prop conflict settings, and shadow rendering.
